import json
rot=lambda a:[list(r) for r in zip(*a[::-1])]
a=g;b=rot(a);c=rot(rot(rot(a)));d=rot(rot(a))
out=[a[i]+b[i] for i in range(5)]+[c[i]+d[i] for i in range(5)]
print(json.dumps(out))
